outlook.statement: The Company does not anticipate any adverse impact on its operations in the near future considering the nature of services and facilities rendered and provided by the Company to the Bajaj Group Companies.

risks: The current and future financial performance of the Company is linked to and is directly related to the services rendered and dividend payouts by the listed companies of the Bajaj Group in which it holds its investments.

The Company is totally dependent on all such companies/entities of the Bajaj Group for its business and any future change in their business plans to avail the aforesaid services and facilities from the Company might adversely affect the operations of the Company.
Price Risk on investments in equity securities and mutual funds
Interest Rate Risk (though Company has no borrowings)
Concentration risk: The Company has earned revenue of more than 10% of its total revenue from its external parties amounting to Rs. 237.07 Lakhs (P.Y. Rs. 231.99 Lakhs).
